{"sql":"WITH attempts AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('week', event_date)::DATE AS week_start,
        platform,
        doc_type,
        app_version,
        COUNT(*) AS n_attempts,
        AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS approval_rate,
        AVG(CASE WHEN reject_reason = 'doc_unreadable' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS doc_unreadable_share,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reject_reason = 'doc_unreadable') AS doc_unreadable_attempts
    FROM fct_kyc_attempts
    WHERE event_date >= DATE '2025-09-15'
      AND event_date <= DATE '2025-12-15'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
), releases AS (
    SELECT platform, version, release_date
    FROM stg_app_releases
    WHERE release_date <= DATE '2025-12-15'
)
SELECT
    a.week_start,
    a.platform,
    a.doc_type,
    a.app_version,
    r.release_date,
    a.n_attempts,
    a.approval_rate,
    a.doc_unreadable_attempts,
    a.doc_unreadable_share
FROM attempts a
LEFT JOIN releases r
  ON r.platform = a.platform
 AND r.version = a.app_version
ORDER BY a.week_start, a.platform, a.doc_type, a.app_version","rationale":"This compares weekly KYC attempt approval rates and unreadable-document rejection shares by platform, document type, and app version, with release dates, to identify whether a recent release explains the drop."}
